skill.displayName: FlyWise — Student Flight Price API (留学生机票实时查询)
skill.summary: 当用户想查询中国出发/到达的航班实时票价、对比航司价格、判断现在是不是该下手，或获取留学生常用航线（北京/上海/广州 ↔ 美东/美西/英国/澳洲/欧洲/东南亚）的购买建议时，调用此技能。买家通过本 Skill 向 flywise 服务端发起航班搜索请求，完成支付（0.03 元/次）后可获取：实时最低价、Top-1...

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release. Pay-per-call $0.004 (¥0.03) / search via Alipay AI Pay (A2M HTTP 402). Returns real-time lowest prices + Top-N flights (carrier/aircraft/cabin/layover) + 30-day price history + AI buy-now/wait recommendation. Routes: China <-> US/UK/AU/CA/EU/SEA. Free to discover; fee charged only on successful resource delivery.
